text_block_list.text:
Mwahahaha! That's all there is to it!
Well, what do
you think, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
How impressed are you?! Go on, you can
praise
me as much as you want!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Whatever could you mean, Suzuka? As
you can
see, I'm absolutely sublime.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
You ran fantastically, but... your eyes
look
different.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It's almost like you're a different person.
Like
you've been swept away by
something.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Engulfed? The only thing I can possibly
think of
being engulfed by... is good
fortune. Is that a bad
thing?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
It's true I'm not really acting like myself.
I've been
letting luck lead me along and
control my actions.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm not really doing anything. I
just go
wherever the tides of fortune
take me...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
It's like I'm possessed by a fox spirit...
I've forked
over my entire being just to
win...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
These thoughts stop her dead in her
tracks. The
luck that she was always
faithful to appears to be
turning into
something dark and sinister.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I tell her that our next goal is the
Takarazuka
Kinen. She doesn't respond.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
